title: Behind every safe voyage
summary: We’re working with the shipping industry to make safety and crew welfare expectations clearer and more consistent for the people on board.
body_markdown:
## Safety starts with crew wellbeing


On board a vessel, safe operations depend on crews being able to make good decisions, speak up, stay alert and respond to changing conditions.


That becomes harder when people are fatigued, disconnected or under pressure. It becomes easier when they are well-rested, supported by strong systems and confident that their concerns will be heard.


Crew welfare is central to safe shipping. A safe vessel is not only one with reliable equipment and clear procedures. People on board also need the support to work safely, look after one another and return home well.


We charter vessels to move the materials the world needs across global trade routes.


That gives us both a responsibility and an opportunity to help lift standards beyond our own operations. But, we cannot do that alone. Our supply chain works best when shipowners, operators, managers and charterers are aligned on what safe, responsible operations look like in practice.


Improving crew welfare requires shared expectations, practical action and a common commitment to the people who keep the industry moving.
